meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 运行 /caveman-stats 时，Claude 本身不计算，而是由配套钩子直接读取会话日志，显示真实 token 用量、预估节省、规则开销和净节省；若净节省为负会如实说明。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中输入 /caveman-stats 时触发，由钩子注入输出。

say.note: 立即显示本会话的 token 用量和预估节省

say.text: 查看这次会话的真实 token 用量
看看规则开销和净节省是多少
say.note: 同样会调用 /caveman-stats 展示明细

howto.what_en: Running /caveman-stats, the model does not compute; a hook reads the session log and shows real token usage, estimated savings, rule overhead, and net savings. If net is negative, it says so plainly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /caveman-stats in Claude Code; the hook injects the output.

say_en.note: Shows token usage and estimated savings immediately

say_en.text: Show the real token usage for this session
What's the rule overhead and net savings?
